property_mix.era: predominantly post-war and 1960s–1970s, with some Victorian terraces from steel industry era
property_mix.notable: Consett's housing stock reflects its industrial past; many properties feature original period locks and timber frames requiring specialist attention. Post-war estates dominate, with substantial council housing stock.

locksmith_relevant: Victorian and Edwardian terraces from steel works era often have period locks, heavy timber doors, and non-standard mechanisms needing specialist knowledge.
Post-war council estates comprise significant proportion of stock; many residents still use older pin-tumbler or mortice systems rather than modern cylinders.
Consett's semi-detached suburbs (1960s–70s expansion) typically feature standard Yale and Chubb locks; high volume of rekeying and cylinder replacement work available.
